parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth in Kbps.

> This parameter is not yet available.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The \`ClientToken\` parameter value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the replication pair-consistent group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DestinationRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the disaster recovery site is located.

parameters.name: DestinationZoneId
parameters.description: The ID of the zone where the disaster recovery site is located.

parameters.name: EnableRtc
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: Disable RTC.

- true: Enable RTC.

Default value: false.

> If you set this parameter to true, RTC is enabled for the replication pair-consistent group. RTC is also enabled for all asynchronous replication pairs that are added to the group.

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the replication pair-consistent group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: RPO
parameters.description: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair-consistent group, in seconds. The only supported value is 900.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the replication pair-consistent group resides. This is the same as the region of the production site.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the replication pair-consistent group belongs.

parameters.name: SourceZoneId
parameters.description: The ID of the zone where the production site is located.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the resource. You can add up to 20 tags.
